reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Build tiles now display a detailed materials list instead of a single cost chip, making it easier to manage your resources. Each entry shows stored vs required materials, with shortages highlighted for your convenience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Update: Materials Instead of Cost Badges
steam.body: We're pleased to announce a new update for Provincia! Build tiles will now show a materials control that details stored vs required resources, making it easier to manage your colony's construction needs. This change replaces the previous single cost chip system, providing a clearer overview of what you have and what you need. For more information, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
